text:
Sage Lin: Hey team! Sage here — super excited to join as a Platform Engineer. First day today in the SF office. :wave: Quick q: where do folks usually grab lunch around here? Any must-try spots? I'm also trying to figure out coffee/desk setup (I love very strong coffee).

Harper Sinclair: welcome Sage! :tada: Best lunch is Parcel (sandwiches) or Ramen Tatsu two blocks over. For coffee, we have a French press in the kitchen and a Nespresso — feel free to stash beans on the shelf labeled 'Sage'. Also come find me for a desk tour.

Mira Patel: hey Sage! Welcome :) If you like tiny bakeries, Bakesmith has the best scones. We sometimes order group lunches on Wed. If you prefer tea we have Earl Grey + jasmine in the pantry.

Jo Rivera: Welcome!! FYI there's a whiteboard near 3B for sticky notes, and plants are fair game. If you want company for lunch, ping me around noon.

Amelia: +1 to Parcel. There's a fridge etiquette rule: label your food and no mystery Tupperwares >48h. :grimacing: Also FYI we put lunch orders in #lunch-orders Slack on Wed.

Ralph: Hey Sage — if you're into bikes, we do a lunchtime roll on Fridays. Also for strong coffee: add two scoops and heat 90s -> drinkable. :bike:

Sage Lin: awesome, thanks all! Quick poll: coffee or tea? vote with emoji :coffee: or :tea:

Harper Sinclair: :coffee:

Mira Patel: :tea:

Jo Rivera: :coffee:

Amelia: :coffee:

Ralph: :coffee:

Sage Lin: thanks! I'll bring bagels tomorrow to say hi to everyone :bagel: See you at 11:30 by the kitchen for a quick intro.
